summary: Federal Communications Commission urges preservation of E-Rate program to ensure broadband access for schools and libraries, citing cost and operational impacts of reduced support. The text expresses opposition to limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, emphasizing its importance for modern education and student success.

claims.argument: Without E-Rate, districts would face increased costs and budget pressures
claims.evidence_quote: Without e-rate, we would have to consider adding additional levy asks of our local tax payers, delay necessary technology and security upgrades, or figure out how to go without.

claims.argument: The text argues against limiting E-Rate to save costs.
claims.evidence_quote: in modern education. As our nation seeks to prepare students for college, careers, and an increasingly technology-driven economy, now is not the time to undermine the very program and related infrastructure that makes those opportunities possible.
